mapper.select: SELECT m.id,m.merchant_name,m.status merchant_status,s.store_name,s.address, s.status store_status FROM merchant_store s JOIN merchant m ON m.id=s.merchant_id WHERE s.id=#{storeId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM merchant_application WHERE reserved_merchant_id=#{merchantId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM merchant_agreement_acceptance WHERE merchant_id=#{merchantId} FOR UPDATE
